notes.title: Game development update v4!
notes.content:
As some people have probably noticed, the month of release is already known. We plan to release the game in March. The day will be announced in February. In fact, there's not much left. I just need time to test the game for bugs, implement a few minor things and make a trailer. So be ready, because soon you will be able to look into Spirit Eyes!

[url=https://www.catsinspace.online/]Webiste :)[/url]

notes.title: Game development update v3!
notes.content:
Important changes are made to the game. A tutorial has been added and the ghost calling systems have been improved. In the game it is estimated that there will be around 23 ghost activity events and choices related to them. Your choices affect the ending and the behavior of the spirit. You will also be able to open the guide. Unfortunately, it takes a lot more time to prepare the game, because I have the impression that the game is too short. Still some events are under construction and the saving system is not complete. Either way, I hope the game can be released in the first quarter of 2023. See you soon!
[url=https://www.catsinspace.online]Webite[/url]

notes.title: Game development update v2!
notes.content:
The provisional announcement date is Q1 2023.

A thermometer and a spirit box have been added. The lower the temperature, the more likely a ghost is nearby, and when he says something, it will be displayed. In addition, there is a player stamina mechanism and an inventory system. The menu has also been added. Now there is an event plan and related events to be implemented. See you in the first quarter of the next year ...
[url=https://www.catsinspace.online]Webite[/url]

notes.title: Game development update!
notes.content:
Today I would like to share with you some little updates and features. I wondered if it was a good idea to add another trailer, but gave up because I don't want to show the whole game on video. There will be one more video for sure on the day of the (yet undefined) premiere. A pocket EMP meter has been added to the game. It shows the activity of the spirit in our environment. A wider application will be described in the game. Another function is to interact with the spirit through electronic equipment. The ghost can contact us via radio, telephone, dicaton, laptop, etc. Now I have to connect it with the plot, which requires a lot of time.
Remember, it is up to you to decide how you play the game and whether you will be able to look into Spirit Eyes ...
